items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from the PUP list; significant move as he ramps from ACL. Also TE Elijah Arroyo undergoing shoulder surgery, out for season.
items.why: Full participant recently; 21-day window closing; Macdonald positive on return chance vs KC.
items.implication: Crowds SEA backfield; may ease in with limited snaps initially alongside Wilson/Holani; stash/priority add if available; reverse Wilson volume.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone potential long-term as primary after Walker exit; monitor Week 7 snaps/routes.

items.text: A.J. Brown (ankle) upgrades to full, removed from injury report, will play Week 7 @ CHI.
items.why: First full since IR return; short week but cleared.

items.text: Bears ruled out RB Kyle Monangai for TNF vs Patriots; misses third straight with thumb/turf toe.
items.why: Did not participate; official designation for short week.
items.implication: Elevates remaining CHI RBs (Swift lead) in potential shootout vs NE; return coming soon per beat.
items.opportunity: Full backfield snaps/carries/red-zone for Swift and committee mates vs leaky NE.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, Bears good for yardage; removed from injury report/full, will play TNF.
items.why: First full practice since IR return; elite matchup vs Bears defense; usage returning.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start in potential shootout; upgrade from recent.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes/red-zone vs soft secondary; short-week volume.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed team meetings, lifting, medical, non-football activities. MarShawn Lloyd 49th EPA/rush (54 qualifiers), Kaleb Johnson 53rd; OL mess but both quite bad. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Post-arrest remorse comments; return looms but workload question after layoff.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup value low given inefficiency; Jacobs still RB1 when back but fade short-term if limited.
items.opportunity: If Jacobs out/limited, no strong handcuff; monitor snaps on return.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs Week 7 on workload doubt

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (after no Wednesday start presence); limited work Wednesday per HC; walking with limp noted in reports but progressing.
items.why: Ankle; hope for Week 7 return but not lock; right side of questionable.
items.implication: Monitor Friday designation; if active, full QB1 upside vs CIN; backup contingency if out.
items.opportunity: Pass/run dual-threat volume if cleared; Ravens offense efficiency rebound.

items.text: Saquon Barkley 'in line' to play vs DAL MNF (RB15 rank); efficient in two full games; Dallas top fantasy RB matchup.
items.why: Expected practice/play per prior Rapoport/Schefter pulse; efficiency high.
items.implication: RB1/2 start if active; smash spot.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps/goal-line vs weak DAL run D.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (eligible off IR) not expected ready soon ('will take some time'); biggest Adams beneficiary delayed. Rams only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Adams ruptured hamstring/semitendinosus, procedure, IR; Ferguson delay confirmed by Schefter source.
items.implication: Puka massive target/route share spike ROS; WR1 overall lock in high-volume Rams offense vs soft defenses.
items.opportunity: 25-tgt projection; red-zone/third-down monopoly; ignore recent points, chase volume.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): seeing elite volume; Lions-like gift? Wait Dallas matchup strong for pass catchers.
items.why: Elite volume; soft/pass-friendly matchup themes (Bears/Lions style but DAL).
items.implication: WR2/flex smash; target share stable post any teammate absences.

items.text: Loves RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads, friendly matchups (defenses carved by RBs); Hubbard consistency.
items.why: Volume + matchup juice; Irving/Warren vs weak run Ds.
items.implication: RB2/flex starts; prefer opportunity over recent scoring.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) on workload question after long layoff; Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37) brutal spot; Emanuel Wilson role squeeze with Charbonnet return.
items.why: Jacobs layoff risk; Skattebo tough matchup/role; Wilson crowded.
items.implication: Sit/fade; look elsewhere for RB volume.
items.conflict: Levitan notes backups inefficient but Jacobs facility progress

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32), Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41), Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9): nasty matchups + role/target-share issues (Downs low-scoring offense).
items.why: Defenses that make life miserable; Downs target problems.

items.text: Week 7 snaps/pace: Up TB@CAR (Mayfield return tempo, Panthers PROE high, high combined snaps/points). GB@DET fantasy-friendliest (both faster, high explosives/points). LAR@LV party (Rams need Vegas bounce, high snaps). Slogs: SF@ATL methodical post-Evans, MIA@NYJ lowest snaps/scoring, IND@MIN blitz/slow.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE/POE data; penalty muting volume league-wide but matchup outliers.
items.implication: Stack/pass-catcher priority in up-pace games; avoid slogs for volume plays.
items.opportunity: Higher play volume = more routes/targets/carries in TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV.

items.text: Bears Week 10 bye then soft ROS close: Saints 27th YPP allowed, Lions 24th, Jags 26th, Dolphins 21st, Bills 25th, Packers 3rd, Lions 24th. Season so far mixed (59 pts Wk1, weather, backups, 31 Wk6).
items.why: Soft defensive schedule post-bye; offense showing juice when healthy.
items.implication: Buy low on Bears skill (Williams, Odunze, Swift, Loveland) for playoff push; TNF vs NE start lean possible.
items.opportunity: Pace/snaps uptick potential; target/carry shares in favorable spots.
items.conflict: Berry hates Odunze this week vs NE
